parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a lighter, typically made of durable plastic. It is small and located at the top of the lighter.
parts.Functional_description: The button is pressed to release gas and create a spark, igniting the flame.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed, returning to its original position after release.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the lighter, made of plastic and designed to hold the fuel reservoir and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, houses the fuel, and serves as the grip area for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the stable base for the lighter’s mechanism.
